column1: # WHICH FILES A DEPLOY SHIPS, and where they land on the target.
#   <repo-relative source> <TAB> <absolute path on the target> [<TAB> flags]
# Flags (comma-separated, optional):
#   host-generated   written by `voipappz setup` ON THE HOST and gitignored, so
#                    it never exists in a checkout or in CI. Still shipped, but
#                    its absence from the repo is not an error.
# WHY THIS IS DATA AND NOT CODE. It is a property of THIS STACK — which configs
# this compose file needs on a node — not of whatever tool does the copying. The
# CLI is moving to va-crystal (docs/next-cli-boundary.md) and `deploy` is
# becoming shell; both read this. A Crystal constant could not be read by either
# once they part company, and a second copy is how two lists drift.
# THE INVARIANT THIS EXISTS FOR (pbx20, 2026-06-04/05): every relative
# config-file bind-mount in docker-compose.yaml must appear here. A missing
# entry means the source does not exist on the target, so Docker creates an
# empty DIRECTORY and mounts it OVER the image's baked config. Two services came
# up broken that way — FreeSWITCH on dev-tree mounts, and kamailio on a
# `kamailio.lua` that compose mounted but no deploy ever copied.
# `scripts/check-deploy-manifest.sh` enforces it, in `make checks` and in CI.
docker-compose.yaml
# Itself. The binary resolves this file against the project root, which on a
# deployed node is /opt/va — so a manifest that never ships leaves `voipappz
# checks` on that node reading a path that does not exist.
config/deploy-manifest.tsv
# The service catalog, for the same reason: `up` reads it to know what to start.
config/services.tsv
.env
config/kong/kong.yaml
config/va.yaml
# app profile (ported from va-installer 2026-07-02)
config/pgcat/pgcat.toml
config/nats/nats.conf
config/gatus/config.node.yaml
# Kamailio KEMI Lua hooks. Ships even though the cfg only calls into it when
# built with -A WITH_LUA: the file must exist on the target before the flag can
# ever be flipped, and shipping it unconditionally keeps the bind mount from
# empty-dir-clobbering /etc/kamailio/lua.
config/kamailio/lua/custom.lua
# kamailio-ingress (INGRESS SBC, incoming direction). Full KEMI: the cfg wires
# the engine and the .lua holds every route, so the cfg is useless without it —
# both must ship.
config/kamailio/ingress/kamailio.cfg
config/kamailio/ingress/kamailio.lua
# tls.so's config. The ingress terminates TLS for the SIP plane (the egress
# dropped it in 69dd660), and enable_tls=1 with an unreadable config or cert
# exits kamailio 255 — so this must be a FILE on the target, not an empty dir
# docker invented over the mount.
config/kamailio/ingress/tls.cfg
# The ingress's destinations. GENERATED from va.yaml by `voipappz setup` and
# rewritten by `voipappz sbc ingress sync`, but tracked and shipped like any
# other config: compose bind-mounts it, and a missing bind-mount source makes
# docker create an empty DIRECTORY over the path — kamailio then reads no
# destinations and 404s every call.
config/kamailio/ingress/dispatcher.list
